param.name: alignments
param.label: Alignment files
param.help: Coordinate-sorted BAM or CRAM files, one per sample. Each sample gets its own panel in the plot.

param.label: Reference genome
param.help: Required when any of the alignments are CRAM. Must be the FASTA the CRAM files were encoded against.
